title.rendered: Aveonix Website Redesign: How We Did It in 10 Days

metadata.title: Aveonix Website Redesign in 10 Days | Creativate Agency
metadata.description: Discover how Creativate completed the Aveonix website redesign in just 10 days—delivering a fresh logo and a sleek, modern site ahead of schedule.

content.rendered:
If there’s one thing all creative agency teams are familiar with, it’s this: in the fast-paced world of branding and design, adaptability and speed are the ultimate game-changers. Every client brings a unique set of challenges, timelines, and goals, and it’s our job to deliver exceptional results—no matter the constraints. At Creativate, we love rising to the occasion, finding innovative solutions, and helping our clients shine.


So, when Aveonix approached us with a bold request and a unique challenge, we knew we had to bring our A-game.

A Little Backstory

Aveonix came to us after a long hiatus. They were ready to re-enter the market with a fresh identity, but there was a catch: the timeline was tight.
The deadline? Two weeks.
The deliverables? A revamped logo and a sleek, fully functional website.
This was no small ask. But at Creativate, we thrive on challenges, so our team jumped into action.

The Starting Line: Understanding the Mission

Our first step was understanding Aveonix’s vision. A brand isn’t just a logo or a website; it’s an identity. They wanted something modern, professional, and reflective of their renewed energy. Given their tight deadline, we knew that a streamlined process was key.

The Plan: Speed Meets Strategy

Tight deadlines call for smart strategies. With time constraints looming, we decided on a template-based approach for the website. While custom designs are often our go-to, this was the best way to ensure we met the timeline without compromising on quality.


As a creative agency, we believe transparency is key to client interactions. We discussed this approach with Aveonix upfront. After weighing the pros and cons, they were fully aligned with the plan. This decision allowed us to focus on quality while maintaining speed.

The Execution: From Concept to Creation
During Week 1: Template Selection and Logo Design

Finding the perfect website template was the first big task. It had to align with Aveonix’s branding, functionality, and aesthetic preferences. This was a collaborative process, involving brainstorming sessions and feedback loops between our team and Aveonix, until we locked in on a template that ticked all the boxes.


While the website template search was in full swing, we also got to work on the logo. Over just a couple of days, we crafted multiple iterations, refining the design until it encapsulated Aveonix’s modern identity perfectly.

In Week 2: Website Development and Final Touches

Once the template was finalised, our developers jumped into action.


Meanwhile, content development was underway. Aveonix provided key details for their web pages, including the ‘Home’ and ‘About Us’ sections. Our content and design teams worked in tandem, aligning every copy and visual with the brand’s personality.


Within two days, the ‘Home’ and ‘About Us’ pages were live, impressing our clients with the speed and quality of our work. Aveonix was thrilled with the quick progress, but we didn’t stop there. We made minor tweaks based on their feedback to ensure every detail was perfect and that the final product exceeded expectations.

The Finish Line: A Brand New Look in Record Time!

The outcome? A brand-new website and a revamped logo for Aveonix, delivered in just 10 days—two days ahead of the already ambitious deadline. The final product was a modern, cohesive brand identity and an elegant, functional website that positioned Aveonix for a powerful comeback. Their satisfaction and renewed confidence in their brand made the entire sprint worthwhile.


This project proved that with the right strategies, even the tightest deadlines don’t have to mean compromising on quality.

Why Partner with Creativate?

This project highlights what makes Creativate unique: our ability to adapt, collaborate, and deliver exceptional quality—no matter the challenge. Whether you’re rebranding, launching a new project, or need creative solutions on a tight timeline, we’re here to make it happen.
